channel.title: React Bits changelog
channel.description: Keep up with the newest additions to React Bits.

item.title: Updated: Glass Surface
item.description: Turn any SVG logo into glass, with a polished frosted look in Safari and Firefox. The new demo glass follows your cursor and can be dragged.

item.title: Updated: Pixel Snow
item.description: Rebuilt with crisp pixel-art flakes in layers of depth, a soft glow, wind and cursor play, snow that can pile up, and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Plasma
item.description: Rebuilt as soft folds of satin light with bright highlights, a cursor that turns them in 3D and a new light mode.

item.title: Updated: Plasma Wave
item.description: Smoother, faster plasma with soft glow, white-hot cores and a cursor that stirs it, plus a new light mode.

item.title: Updated: Radar
item.description: Rebuilt as a detailed radar scope with a glowing sweep, contacts that ping and fade, a sonar mode and a tilted floor view.

item.title: Updated: Specular Button
item.description: Rebuilt with a crisp glass edge whose light glides around the rim toward the cursor, rests softly when idle and flashes on press.

item.title: Updated: Acid Squares
item.description: Crisp glass edges, travelling rings of light and twinkling squares, plus a clean light mode.

item.title: Updated: Carousel
item.description: Rebuilt with momentum swiping, five transitions, photo cards, an autoplay timer and a cleaner frame in both themes.

item.title: Updated: Elastic Mesh
item.description: Rebuilt as inflated, squishy type and logos that dent, stretch and snap back with a jiggle.

item.title: Updated: Flying Posters
item.description: Rebuilt so it only scrolls when you use it, with optional columns and a camera you can pull back or push in.

item.title: Updated: Ghost Fibers
item.description: Sharper fibers with crisp cores and a cleaner glow, plus a light mode that matches the dark one.

item.title: Updated: Glass Icons
item.description: Rebuilt with real liquid glass that bends light at its edges, a smooth entrance, new card styles and presets.

item.title: Updated: Glow Cursor
item.description: Rebuilt as light that pours from the cursor and drifts softly as it fades, with a burst on click and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Halftone Reveal
item.description: Rebuilt as a print on the page in mono, duotone or full color, with dots that swell into the photo.

item.title: Updated: Infinite Menu
item.description: Rebuilt to be lighter, with more ways to shape the tiles, autoplay, keyboard support and click to select.

item.title: Updated: Iridescence
item.description: Rebuilt with full control over color, folds and motion, a liquid stir under the cursor, a swirl on click and presets.

item.title: Updated: Laser Flow
item.description: Rebuilt as a waterfall of light that lands on your content, pours over its corners and can reveal your UI around the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Shape Blur
item.description: Rebuilt as a real lens blur that follows the cursor. Use any SVG or PNG as the shape, or switch to focus mode.

item.title: Updated: Sliced Waves
item.description: Rebuilt as waves of light sliced into glowing bars, seen in depth with a focus that follows the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Threads
item.description: Rebuilt to run several times faster, with presets, much more control over the threads and a cursor that parts them.

item.title: New: Holo Card
item.description: Collectible trading card with a real holographic foil.

item.title: Updated: ASCII Text
item.description: Rebuilt so the layers never slip apart on load, with a scramble on hover, click ripples and custom characters.

item.title: Updated: Blob Cursor
item.description: Rebuilt as a smooth 3D liquid that stretches as it moves, with new looks, drips and a splashy click burst.

item.title: Updated: Bounce Cards
item.description: Rebuilt on springs, so hovering no longer flickers. The fan is easier to shape and cards can now be clicked.

item.title: Updated: Crosshair
item.description: Rebuilt from scratch. It frames what you hover with measuring brackets, with new line styles and a click pulse.

item.title: Updated: Decay Card
item.description: Rebuilt to run smoother. The decay now shows at normal speeds, spreads evenly and frays gently when idle.

item.title: Updated: Dock
item.description: Rebuilt with smoother magnification, a right-click menu, badges, auto hide and placement on any edge.

item.title: Updated: Gradient Text
item.description: Rebuilt with new flow and conic styles, a soft glow and colors that drift toward the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Grid Distortion
item.description: Rebuilt to be lighter. Images no longer stretch, and new modes range from crisp blocks to a liquid warp.

item.title: Updated: Grid Motion
item.description: Rebuilt to fit its container, with drift, parallax, a 3D tilt and a spotlight that follows the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Hyperspeed
item.description: Rebuilt with a real glow and a transparent background. Every part of the road and lights is now customizable.

item.title: Updated: Lanyard
item.description: Rebuilt with no setup needed. Pass any image and the card swings with real momentum and flips on click.

item.title: Updated: Noise
item.description: Rebuilt to be much lighter, with film dust, scratches, scanlines and flicker for a real film look.

item.title: Updated: Pixel Transition
item.description: Rebuilt to stay smooth on quick hovers, with new reveal patterns, pixel shapes and a choppy retro mode.

item.title: Updated: Shiny Text
item.description: Rebuilt with more control over the shine, a travelling glow and new ways to play it, like on hover or scroll.

item.title: Updated: Spotlight Card
item.description: Rebuilt with a smoother light that follows the cursor, glows along the edge and can be shared across a grid.

item.title: Updated: Stack
item.description: Rebuilt so cards never jump mid-drag. Throws carry momentum, with four new layouts and keyboard support.

item.title: Updated: Star Border
item.description: Rebuilt from scratch. The star glides evenly around any shape with a soft trail, hover laps and a click pulse.

item.title: New: Crystalized Ball
item.description: A glass ball held together by a crackling electric rim, with a bowl of glowing dust inside that swirls in the cursor wake, shakes on click and lights up on mount, all from one color.

item.title: Updated: Shape Waves
item.description: Centered text cutouts using actual glyph bounds.

item.title: New: Pattern Waves
item.description: A lit halftone surface of dots, lines, crosses or glyphs that moves like draped silk, rolling swells or ripples, with six presets, one-color theming and a cursor that sends ripples through it.

item.title: New: Circular Carousel
item.description: A 3D ring of images with four layouts, bendable cards, depth fade, momentum drag, snapping and click to focus.

item.title: Updated: Electric Logo
item.description: Added an onRender callback for capturing live frames and reflection effects.

item.title: New: Micro Slats
item.description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests, four presets, a real fluid the cursor stirs and an intro that rolls in from the horizon.

item.title: New: Flex Carousel
item.description: An infinite image row that flows through invisible liquid glass at its edges, with four bend presets, five entrances, a speed squeeze and click to focus.

item.title: New: Electric Logo
item.description: Turns any SVG or PNG into a living lightning outline, with flowing strands, arcs that leap off the edges and a charge that follows the cursor.

item.title: New: Tech Text
item.description: A wordmark whose letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor.

item.title: New: Dither Veil
item.description: A photo printed as a 1-bit dither that the cursor burns through to full colour, leaving a trail that knits back cell by cell.

item.title: New: Shredder
item.description: A list with a paper shredder at the bottom.

item.title: New: Paper Crumple
item.description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while held and follows the grabbed point as you drag.

item.title: New: Flip Card
item.description: Two-faced card that flips in 3D on a click, a drag or a flick, settling on a spring that carries your release velocity, with an optional cursor tilt, a sheen that follows the pointer and a shadow that narrows as it turns edge on.

item.title: New: Tear Ticket
item.description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand: paper bridges stretch into fibres and snap one by one from the far end, the torn edges are jagged and fit each other, the freed stub dangles and drops, and the body is stamped as used.

item.title: New category: Micro
item.description: A new category of small, satisfying interactions: switches, buttons, sliders, toasts, menus, loaders and more. Launched with 30 components: Bell Toggle, Branched Menu, Call Chip, Code Slots, Comet Dial, Dodge Field, Folder Float, Fuse Button, Glide Select, Hold Button, Jelly Radio, Lattice Loader, Peek Rating, Prompt Bar, Pulse Heart, Refine Frame, Rubber Segment, Scrub Field, Slide Commit, Sling Button, Slosh Gauge, Spring Check, Squish Switch, Status Mark, Swipe Row, Swipe Toast, Thought Line, Voice Pill, Wake Slider, Warm Tooltip.

item.title: New: Shape Waves
item.description: A WebGPU field of triangles, circles and squares that brighten and grow along rolling waves, with an optional text cutout the waves flow around.
